directive.thread_id: cloud job 2026-11-03: one search over everything a person keeps comes back (relaunch, lead-66 bulk move of trillion features into the Workshop)
directive.quote: Move search_everything_at's merging (records + files, reciprocal rank) into a Workshop tool, trillion-workshop tools/search-everything-with-one-question/, ported one to one from old trillion src/search.mjs:1750 finish and src/file-tools.mjs:125. Delete search_everything_at from trillion-rust src/native_boot/mcp_local.rs in the same change. Move code, never rewrite it.

old_copy.deleted_with: Trillion-X/trillion 4ffa1dc4a, which retired old trillion's Worker and deleted src/search.mjs; the engine's port of the same job (trillion-rust search_everything_at and record_value::search::merged) is deleted in this move's trillion-rust change

preserve: every lane is asked with the same question, cut to 500 characters, its terms the distinct words of at least min_word_length
a lane that cannot answer is named unavailable with its lane, place, source and reason, never guessed; its owners' pending are kept
each lane ranks its own hits by score, one place per thing
reciprocal rank fusion: a thing is worth each lane's rank times its weight over (k + its rank in that lane), summed over the lanes it was found in, so lanes add by rank, never by raw score
one thing per file or record, with its places, its moments and its fused score, best first, cut to limit
the word gate: a words-in-index lane whose best hit holds under word_confidence_floor of the asked words sits the question out
allowed_deltas: finish is a function inside searchEverything(input, { door }), and its lanes are the engine's two storage reads (read-data/settings.json lanes): records:search, whose every record kind is its own lane, and the files' name search, asked only when no type narrows the question
a hit keeps the lane its owner gave it ({ lane, ...hit }), so record kinds are ranked apart as the engine ranked them
hiddenAmong (a SQL read of set-aside files) is dropped: the files' search answers only named files; a file is its own canonical identity
a refusal of the records' search is the answer's refusal (thrown), as the engine kept it
the candidate fusion sessions (src/search.mjs 1799-1892), the learned weights and the answer log read the old Worker's SQL and are not carried; every weight is 1
a result is its owner's hit (title, said, address) with found_in, places, moments, said and the fused score, instead of the old file description rows
banned_substitutions: a second copy of the merge left in trillion-rust (search_everything_at and record_value::search::merged are deleted in the same move)
